interpretation: 3D separations are model-based estimates from redshift-space positions, not light-travel times or separations at either emission epoch. Peculiar velocities, redshift errors, and cosmological parameter errors are not propagated. Decimal digits do not indicate physical accuracy.

image_geometry.pixel_convention: zero-based pixel centers; x right, y up in origin=lower plots

dataset.redshift_uncertainty_note: No published z_Spec uncertainty column in this table; line-flux errors are not redshift errors.
dataset.selection: All NIRCam-matched flag-A sources inside the existing cutout, z>0, DR_flag=False, deduplicated by NIRCam_ID across all tiers. Existing canonical IDs retained; otherwise lexicographic TIER:NIRSpec_ID tie-break.

apparent_size.match_note: ID plus sky match within 0.2 arcsec; nearest sky match if IDs changed through re-segmentation. Unavailable sizes remain null.

dataset.id_convention: TIER:NIRSpec_ID; NIRCam_ID is retained separately, not used interchangeably.
